behaviour: Provide styles for the PageTabs bar, individual page tabs, inline rename input, reorder buttons, and add/delete controls.
rules: 1. Import variables with @use "../css/variables.module" as *; and scope all styles under .excalidraw .page-tabs.

2. Style .page-tabs as a compact horizontal flex bar with pointer-events: var(--ui-pointer-events), rounded island background, scrollable .page-tabs__list, active state .page-tabs__tab--active, inline input .page-tabs__rename-input, and action buttons .page-tabs__action-btn and .page-tabs__add-btn.

style_from.reason: Follow Excalidraw SCSS module import and .excalidraw scoping conventions.

behaviour: Render the page tab bar allowing users to switch pages, add a page, rename a page inline, reorder pages, and delete a page with confirmation.
rules: 1. Export const PageTabs = ({ appState }: { appState: UIAppState }) => JSX.Element reading app via useApp() and translations via t() from ../i18n.

2. Render a container with role="tablist" and aria-label={t("pages.tabsLabel")} containing a tab for each page in appState.pages with role="tab", aria-selected={page.id === appState.activePageId}, data-testid={`page-tab-${page.id}`}, and draggable={!appState.viewModeEnabled && editingPageId !== page.id}.

3. Clicking a tab calls app.switchPage(page.id); double-clicking a tab (or clicking its rename button with data-testid={`page-rename-${page.id}`} and aria-label={t("pages.renamePage")}) when !appState.viewModeEnabled opens an inline input (data-testid={`page-rename-input-${page.id}`}) initialized to page.name that commits via app.renamePage(page.id, draftName) on Enter or blur and cancels on Escape (stopping key event propagation so canvas shortcuts do not fire while typing).

4. Support reordering pages when !appState.viewModeEnabled both via HTML5 drag-and-drop (onDragStart, onDragOver, onDrop calling app.reorderPages(fromIndex, toIndex)) and via move-left / move-right buttons (data-testid={`page-move-left-${page.id}`} and data-testid={`page-move-right-${page.id}`}, disabled at boundaries).

5. When !appState.viewModeEnabled, render an Add Page button (data-testid="page-add-button", aria-label={t("pages.addPage")}) that calls app.addPage(), and a Delete Page button per tab (data-testid={`page-delete-${page.id}`}, aria-label={t("pages.deletePage")}, disabled when appState.pages.length <= 1) that opens ConfirmDialog (titled t("pages.deletePageConfirmTitle") with body t("pages.deletePageConfirmDescription", { pageName: page.name })) and calls app.deletePage(page.id) on confirm.
6. When appState.viewModeEnabled is true, allow clicking tabs to switch pages while hiding or disabling add, rename, reorder, and delete controls.

style_from.reason: Follow Excalidraw component structure, ConfirmDialog usage, i18n t() calls, and hooks.

uses.reason: Use ConfirmDialog for confirming page deletion.

behaviour: Search across all pages in SearchMenu, display the page name for matches when multiple pages exist, and switch to the matched element's page on selection.
rules: 1. Import getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.
2. Add pageId: string and pageName?: string to SearchMatchItem.

3. In handleSearch, read all non-deleted elements across all pages via app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements(), build a pageNameMap from app.state.pages, and populate pageId: getElementPageId(el) and pageName on each SearchMatchItem (preferring matches on app.state.activePageId or visibleIds for the initial focusIndex).

4. In the focusIndex effect (lines 195-255), when match is selected and match.pageId !== app.state.activePageId, call app.switchPage(match.pageId) before computing viewport bounds and calling app.viewport.setViewport.

5. In ListItem and MatchListBase, pass pageName={app.state.pages.length > 1 ? searchMatch.pageName : undefined} to ListItem and render it inside the result item so users see which page each search match belongs to.

Accept optional pageName on ListItem, display it when present, and pass pageName from searchMatch in MatchListBase.

behaviour: Implement multi-page state management, page actions (addPage, switchPage, renamePage, reorderPages, deletePage), viewport persistence per page, and scene/history synchronization in App.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME, and randomId from @excalidraw/common and getElementPageId, withElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.

2. Expose getAllSceneElements = () => this.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements() and getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted = () => this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted(), and wire getAllSceneElements, getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted, addPage, switchPage, renamePage, reorderPages, and deletePage into createExcalidrawAPI().

3. Implement addPage = (name?: string): string => creates a new page { id: randomId(), name: trimmedName || t("pages.defaultPageName", { pageNumber: this.state.pages.length + 1 }) }, saves the outgoing page's viewport { scrollX: this.state.scrollX, scrollY: this.state.scrollY, zoom: this.state.zoom } in pageViewports[currentActivePageId], switches scene and history activePageId to the new page ID, resets scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue } and transient selection/editing state, commits CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER to this.store, and updates state.

4. Implement switchPage = (pageId: string): void => if pageId exists in this.state.pages and pageId !== this.state.activePageId, saves the outgoing page's { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } into pageViewports[this.state.activePageId], loads incomingViewport = pageViewports[pageId] ?? { scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue } }, updates this.scene.setActivePageId(pageId) and this.history.setActivePageId(pageId), clears transient selection/hover/editing state (selectedElementIds: {}, hoveredElementIds: {}, selectedGroupIds: {}, editingTextElement: null, editingGroupId: null, editingFrame: null, activeEmbeddable: null, selectionElement: null, multiElement: null, selectedLinearElement: null), commits CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER to this.store with the new active page's elementsMap and next state, and calls this.setState.

5. Implement renamePage = (pageId: string, name: string): void => updates the target page's name in this.state.pages (trimming whitespace and falling back to t("pages.defaultPageName", { pageNumber: index + 1 }) if empty).

6. Implement reorderPages = (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): void => moves the page at fromIndex to toIndex in this.state.pages when indices are valid and distinct without altering activePageId or elements.

7. Implement deletePage = (pageId: string): void => if this.state.pages.length <= 1 or pageId is not found, return; remove pageId from pages and pageViewports, call this.scene.deletePageElements(pageId) (which tombstones the deleted page's elements via newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }) with a version bump for collaboration reconciliation) and this.history.deletePageHistory(pageId), and if pageId === this.state.activePageId switch to the adjacent remaining page (pages[Math.min(deletedIndex, remainingPages.length - 1)].id), restoring its viewport and committing CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER to this.store.

8. In syncActionResult, updateScene, initializeScene, resetScene, and loadFileToCanvas, keep this.scene.setActivePageId and this.history.setActivePageId synchronized with appState.activePageId, and pass { allPages: true } to this.scene.replaceAllElements when replacing the full scene; in componentDidUpdate, attach non-enumerable __allElements and __activeElements getters onto this.state so serializeAsJSON can access all pages' elements when given this.state.

sites.rule: Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME, randomId from @excalidraw/common and getElementPageId, withElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.
Wire getAllSceneElements, getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted, addPage, switchPage, renamePage, reorderPages, and deletePage in createExcalidrawAPI().
Add getAllSceneElements, getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted, addPage, switchPage, renamePage, reorderPages, and deletePage methods on App.
Synchronize scene.setActivePageId and history.setActivePageId when actionResult.appState?.activePageId is provided.
Reset scene activePageId to DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, replaceAllElements([], { allPages: true }), and reset history activePageId in resetScene.
Set scene and history activePageId to restoredAppState.activePageId and replace all pages' elements in initializeScene.
Attach non-enumerable __allElements and __activeElements onto this.state in componentDidUpdate before store.commit and onChange.
Normalize pasted/library elements to this.state.activePageId with withElementPageId in addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary.
In updateScene, sync scene.setActivePageId and history.setActivePageId when appState.activePageId changes.

behaviour: Encrypt and decrypt the ordered pages list together with scene elements inside FirebaseStoredScene ciphertext using roomKey while keeping legacy documents without pages readable.
rules: 1. Import ExcalidrawPage from @excalidraw/excalidraw/types.

2. Keep FirebaseStoredScene unchanged ({ sceneVersion: number; iv: Bytes; ciphertext: Bytes }) so no plaintext page names are stored outside ciphertext; in encryptElements(key: string, elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[], pages?: readonly ExcalidrawPage[]), serialize pages ? JSON.stringify({ elements, pages }) : JSON.stringify(elements) and encrypt with encryptData(key, encoded) so page names are encrypted with roomKey together with elements.

3. In decryptElements(data: FirebaseStoredScene, roomKey: string), decrypt and JSON.parse the payload; if the parsed value is an array (legacy single-page document without pages), return it directly; if the parsed value is an object with elements, define non-enumerable __pages: parsed.pages on parsed.elements and return parsed.elements.

4. Pass appState.pages to createFirebaseSceneDocument(elements, roomKey, appState.pages) in saveToFirebase, and in both saveToFirebase and loadFromFirebase preserve the decrypted __pages non-enumerable property onto the returned SyncableExcalidrawElement[] array so Collab can restore remote pages.

sites.rule: Import ExcalidrawPage from @excalidraw/excalidraw/types.
Encrypt pages together with elements inside encryptElements and decode both { elements, pages } payloads and legacy element-array payloads in decryptElements.
Pass appState.pages to createFirebaseSceneDocument in saveToFirebase and propagate decrypted non-enumerable __pages onto the elements returned by saveToFirebase and loadFromFirebase.

2. In broadcastScene, include pages: this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages in data.payload.

sites.rule: Use this.collab.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted() in queueFileUpload so images across all pages are saved.
Include pages: this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages in broadcastScene payload.

behaviour: Synchronize all pages' elements and page list updates across collaborators while keeping each user's activePageId and viewport local.
rules: 1. In getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(), return this.excalidrawAPI.getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted() so collaboration reconciles and broadcasts elements across all pages.
2. In WS_SUBTYPES.INIT, WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE, initializeRoom, and saveCollabRoomToFirebase, pass remote pages (decryptedData.payload.pages or (elements as any).__pages) to handleRemoteSceneUpdate.

3. In handleRemoteSceneUpdate(elements, remotePages?), if remotePages is a non-empty array, update appState.pages to remotePages; keep the local user's activePageId and viewport (scrollX, scrollY, zoom) unchanged if activePageId still exists in remotePages, or fall back activePageId to remotePages[0].id (and restore its viewport from pageViewports or default) if the local user's active page was deleted remotely.
4. Track lastBroadcastedOrReceivedPagesJSON on Collab so broadcastElements also broadcasts when appState.pages changes (page added, renamed, reordered, or deleted).

sites.rule: Pass (storedElements as any).__pages to handleRemoteSceneUpdate in saveCollabRoomToFirebase.
Pass decryptedData.payload.pages to handleRemoteSceneUpdate on WS_SUBTYPES.INIT and WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE.

Use this.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted() in loadImageFiles and update handleRemoteSceneUpdate to reconcile remotePages while keeping local activePageId and viewport (or falling back to remotePages[0].id if activePageId was deleted).
